metadata.description: Dzmitry Bahaslouski plugin marketplace for Claude Code

plugins.name: note-taker
plugins.description: Transform meeting transcripts into structured notes with key points, decisions, action items, and follow-ups

plugins.name: git
plugins.description: Git commits with auto-generated messages and preview, plus background code review of branches, PRs and MRs

plugins.name: anki
plugins.description: Turn topics and pages into simple, illustrated Anki cards that fit your collection, plus AnkiConnect MCP access to decks and cards

plugins.name: yt-dlp
plugins.description: Download videos, audio, playlists, subtitles, and metadata from YouTube and any other yt-dlp-supported site via a single conversational skill

plugins.name: mermaid
plugins.description: Render Mermaid diagrams in Claude Code with live reload — preview flowcharts, sequence diagrams, and architecture diagrams in real time

plugins.name: learn
plugins.description: Skills for learning and understanding topics — explain any concept in a short structured chat answer or a clear, illustrated explainer page

plugins.name: database-bundle
plugins.description: Database tools — a read-only database reviewer agent for PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite and other SQL databases, plus production-safe PostgreSQL patterns

plugins.name: google
plugins.description: Google tools for Claude Code — read, search and (optionally) send Google Chat messages, and work with NotebookLM notebooks, sources, audio overviews, quizzes and flashcards
